entries.name: Adrenaline Rush
entries: You can take the {@action Dash|SRD52} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}. When you do so, you gain a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|SRD52} equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|SRD52|Proficiency Bonus}.

You can use this trait a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|SRD52|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|SRD52|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|SRD52} with a range of 120 feet.

entries.name: Relentless Endurance
entries: When you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} instead. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}.
